v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Iurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
text.en: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

text.la: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
text.en: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

text.la: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
text.en: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

text.la: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
text.en: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

text.la: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
text.en: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

text.la: Fratres: Iam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Iesu.
text.en: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Quia vidísti me * Thoma, credidísti: beáti qui non vidérunt, et credidérunt, allelúia.
text.en: Because thou hast seen me, * Thomas, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen and have believed, alleluia.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáti Apóstoli tui Thomæ solemnitátibus gloriári: ut eius semper et patrocíniis sublevémur; et fidem cóngrua devotióne sectémur.
text.en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech thee, to glory in the solemnity of thy blessed Apostle Thomas, that we may ever be aided by his patronage, and follow his faith with true devotion.

title.la: Feria V infra Hebdomadam III Adventus
title.en: Feria V infra Hebdomadam III Adventus

text.la: O Óriens splendor lucis ætérnæ, et sol iustítiæ: veni, et illúmina sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis.
text.en: O Day-Spring, brightness of the everlasting Light, Sun of Righteousness; come, to give light to them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death!

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.
